annotations.title: Coin brief: why it is moving

description: The one-call answer for ONE coin, in causal order: price and 24h move, the news read (summary, mood, headlines), whale flow against its own normal, forced closes, funding and open interest, with recorded-history context. Answers "why is X moving" without a second call. view: brief (default), quick (price, funding, open interest only), funding (rate per exchange), crowding (0-100 crowding read, Pro).

coin.description: Coin symbol, e.g. BTC. A pair like ETH/USD works too.

compact.description: true: one line of text instead of JSON.

cursor.description: Next page: the cursor from the previous answer.

detail.description: brief (default): the answer, key numbers and top rows. full: every row, paged with cursor.

position_usd.description: Position size in USD, to price the funding cost.
